newsitem.title: INDIA: Israel's Weizman hopes Albright will woo Syria.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Weizman hopes Albright will woo Syria.

text.p: Israeli President Ezer Weizman said on Monday he expects U.S. Secretary of State-designate Madeleine Albright would be able to bring Syria into Middle East peace talks.

"Perhaps we'll let the lady try," Weizman told a news conference on the second day of his visit to Delhi. "I have full respect for (outgoing U.S. Secretary of State) Warren Christopher. But where he didn't succeed, the lady will succeed. She has the opportunity, because she has a more ripe situation now than Mr Christopher had."
Albright is due to take over on January 20 from Christopher, who was unable to bring Syria's President Hafez Assad into the peace process.
Weizman said Assad and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak were former air force commanders like him.

Weizman said Israel's talks with the Palestinians over a deal on Hebron were not stuck because of Jewish settlers. "It is not a question of 400 Jews there, but to keep a footing in a holy city, sacred to Jews and to Islam," he said.
Israel and Palestinian negotiators hope to sign an agreement to give Palestinians control of 80 per cent of Hebron.
